partners.mechanism_chain: GABRA1 (HGNC:406) —DISRUPTS→ GABAergic signaling (GO:0007235); GABAergic signaling (GO:0007235) —DECREASES→ Neuronal excitability regulation (GO:0050805); Neuronal excitability regulation (GO:0050805) —LEADS_TO→ Seizure (HP:0001250); ERBB3 (HGNC:3097) —DISRUPTS→ ErbB signaling pathway (REACT:R-HSA-1119937); ErbB signaling pathway (REACT:R-HSA-1119937) —DECREASES→ Neuronal excitability regulation (GO:0050805); Neuronal excitability regulation (GO:0050805) —LEADS_TO→ Autonomic dysfunction (HP:0012314).
